speaker: SURYA
text: The crossing is open. I thought that meant they could finally go home. Why is no one moving?

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Their identities are marked invalid. Transit, food distribution, shelter access—all refused. The district recognizes their bodies, but denies that they belong here.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: They survived the wall. Now they have to prove they exist before someone will give them water. Stay with us. We’ll find another way.

speaker: TITAN
text: No chains. No prison doors. Just a light that says no, and a city trained to look away.

speaker: AURA
text: The scanners aren’t losing their names. Something upstream is removing them. Every rejection carries the same command signature.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: There’s a service passage beneath the processing hall. No public entrance, no queue. That’s usually where they hide the useful doors.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: District identity registry. It controls the exclusion list and holds the original records. Destroying it could erase the only evidence these people have left.

speaker: KAITO
text: Then we keep the records intact. Get inside, recover their identities, and stop the registry from locking them out again.

speaker: SURYA
text: I’ll keep this queue safe. Bring their names back.
